title: Microwave Noises
blurb: The hum of a turntable going round, then the beeps that mean your food is theoretically ready. Kitchen foley gets underrated. This one carries oddly specific associations for anyone who has lived alone: the late-night reheat, the countdown, the door you yank open at two seconds purely to beat the beep. Editors use it for domestic scenes and for gag timing, since an appliance finishing is a natural punchline beat. It doubles as a small cruelty in voice calls — the beeps sound real enough that somebody will get up and check their own kitchen.
origin: A generic recording of a microwave oven running and finishing its cycle.
